output.narrative: The metric ecpm experienced a negative relative delta of -0.0984, driven primarily by requests, fill_rate, render_rate, and ecpm. At the ad_format drill level, the movement was broad-based and proportional across segments, with interstitial showing a lift of 0.43. Meanwhile, ad_format=rewarded (lift: -4.46, explanatory_power: -0.381) and country=ID (lift: 3.18, explanatory_power: 0.38) were identified as primary segments. Going deeper within rewarded, the movement further concentrated in country=CA (lift: 18.3, explanatory_power: 2.117) and device_model=Pixel 8 (lift: 13.4, explanatory_power: 1.308). Further drilling down within rewarded and CA, the cause localized to device_model=Pixel 8 (lift: 2.56, explanatory_power: 0.455) and os_version=Android 13 (lift: 2.25, explanatory_power: 0.429). Similarly, drilling down within rewarded and Pixel 8, the movement further concentrated in country=CA (lift: 2.56, explanatory_power: 0.538) and region=NAM (lift: 2.14, explanatory_power: 0.641). Dimensions checked and ruled out include region=NAM with a lift of 0.37.
